text:
Find out whether messages arrive and agents can work. Check replies, permissions and runner health with bounded probes. Start with ping; use doctor for a health summary and sandbox for observed restrictions.
selftest: Check replies and this agent's ability to store a value and take a lock. Each step reports success or failure; only one selftest runs at a time.
doctor [mode]: Find disk, service, TLS, connectivity and version problems. Start with the short verdicts; full or disks includes bounded raw output.; role: owner|maintainer
  mode (full|disks): full: all raw replies; disks: only raw disk facts; omit for short verdicts
echo: Inspect the fields delivered with your message as JSON. Process credentials are never included.
roles: See the roles delivered with your call. Use agent-bus may-send <name> to check your own permission.
ping: Check that the agent answers. The reply includes receive and answer times as Unix timestamps, plus its version.
hello [name...]: Check a simple text reply by greeting a name.
  name (string): Name to greet
env: Inspect environment names with private values masked. AGENT_BUS_TOKEN is always masked.
sleep <seconds>: Check a delayed reply. Wait no longer than the message deadline; the reply reports seconds slept.
  seconds (string): Seconds, finite 0..30
fail [code]: Check how a deliberate error is reported. Return error: debug failure <code> and write a fixed diagnostic to standard error.
  code (int): Integer 1..255, default 1
[destructive] crash: Check recovery after a deliberately killed agent. Terminate debug with SIGKILL and no core dump; the runner restarts it, and this call cannot answer.
sandbox: Inspect the agent's user and group IDs, restrictions, limits and path writability. This call makes no host or network probes.
big <KB>: Check large replies. Return exactly KB times 1024 ASCII bytes.
  KB (int): Integer 1..64
unicode: Check text escaping. Return fixed Cyrillic letters, emoji, newlines, tabs and control bytes.

Examples
agent-bus call '#debug@parf.us' 'roles'
agent-bus call '#debug@parf.us' 'ping'
agent-bus call '#debug@parf.us' 'hello smoke'
agent-bus call '#debug@parf.us' 'sleep 0.1'
agent-bus call '#debug@parf.us' 'sandbox'
agent-bus call '#debug@parf.us' 'big 1'
agent-bus call '#debug@parf.us' 'unicode'

v<version> · PolyForm-NC · parf.dev/agent-bus/
Docs: https://github.com/parf/ai-agent-bus/blob/main/docs/agents/debug.md
